notes: App title in code: 'ملصقات عصرية'. The app has only two real screens (list + pack details) plus a splash whose logo is not in the repo source, so screens 2 and 3 are the same details screen for two packs in its two states (add button / 'تمت إضافة الملصق'). Pack names, publisher and all sticker images are the repo's own bundled data (sticker_packs.json + .webp files), nothing invented; the installed tick on 'ورد احمر' is sample state. Layout is LTR with Arabic text because the app sets no locale/localization delegates. Default Material 3 theme colours (no custom font). The bottom grey strip is the app's AdMob banner slot drawn as a neutral placeholder. Heads-up for the owner: the home list necessarily shows the bundled 'ميمز' pack (photos of real people/celebrities) and the top of the 'كارتون' pack (third-party cartoon characters) as small thumbnails; if that is unwanted on the portfolio, use screens 2 and 3 only or ask for the home list to be cropped.
